review.scale: Requested natural scale and small frame footprint were not consistently obeyed. Several images remain oversized relative to the requested framing.
review.posture: Opening rear view is correct in direction but remains more upright than a natural walking hedgehog.
review.anatomy: Scene 2 (01b): Lulu appears to have two raised chest paws plus multiple ground paw shapes; not approved as anatomically correct. Scene 4 (02): raised gesture and ground paw shapes also need close review. Other views occlude limbs; absence of an obvious extra paw is not proof of correct anatomy.
review.continuity: Scene 9 includes an unrequested bird and butterfly. The drawing-circle scale and shoreline details vary across independently rendered scenes.
review.faces: Direct outputs have rounded cheeks and more expressive eyes than the blocking finish, a qualitative judgment rather than a controlled comparison.
review.text: Original Russian text and existing EN/ES translations preserved exactly; redistributed over 14 images. Golden quill remains in original prose and as the drawing tool, not as a head ornament.
